nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph Workflow
nodes.rationale: Prefer graphify query/path/explain over raw grep or GRAPH_REPORT.md because they return a scoped subgraph, usually much smaller than the full report or raw source browsing; run graphify update after code changes since it is AST-only and incurs no API cost.

nodes.label: Container Security Hardening
nodes.rationale: Apply defense-in-depth and least-privilege to the production container: read-only root filesystem, dropped capabilities (cap_drop ALL), no-new-privileges, tmpfs for writable paths, and running as non-root UID 1000 to limit blast radius if the app or web server is compromised.
